description: This file defines the StringIPC class, which implements the ObjectIPC interface for handling simple String objects in JSON format, including serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: StringIPC
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a String value and provides methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, implementing the ObjectIPC interface.

methods.name: StringIPC()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating an instance with no initial value.

methods.name: StringIPC(String val)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given String value.

methods.name: getValue()
methods.description: Returns the current String value stored in the object.

methods.name: setValue(String str)
methods.description: Sets the String value in the object.

methods.name: toJSON()
methods.description: Serializes the String value into a JSON object with key 's'.

methods.name: fromJSON(JSONObject buffer)
methods.description: Deserializes the String value from a JSON object, handling optional presence.
